FAQ

Can clients see another client’s projects?

No. Portal access is scoped by session identity and ownership checks before any resource loads.

Do you process live payments today?

Not in the foundation phase. Payment providers are defined and verified server-side before a payment is marked successful.

Where are private files stored?

Private files are stored outside public paths and accessed through authenticated server routes only.
